who: Julia, 29, a freelance illustrator who works alone
talk:
Hey, I'm Julia, I'm twenty-nine, I'm a freelance illustrator and I work alone from my flat in Rotterdam. It's me and my cat Mochi. My boyfriend Daan lives in Amsterdam, we see each other at the weekends. Work is feast or famine. Right now I have a children's book due for a publisher at the end of the month, I'm about halfway, and there are two small logo jobs I keep putting off. I have to file my VAT return by the end of January and I'm a bit scared of it.

Next year I want to raise my rates and get one steady client, so I'm not always chasing work. I also want to finally build my portfolio website. Working at home gets lonely, I'd like to work from a co-working space a couple of days a week. And I really want to stop scrolling my phone in bed.

Oh, and my sister Eva is getting married in May and I'm the maid of honour, so there's a speech and a party to plan. That's me.
now: Two more spreads of the children’s book.
